description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Mannar District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections in the Mannar Administrative District, including the announcement of a new election date (April 25, 2023). It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and contains a schedule listing the specific local government bodies affected. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes, scheduling changes, and election administration.
